title.zh: ENSv2 Activation Proposal Would Halt New ENSv1 Registrations
title.en: ENSv2 Activation Proposal Would Halt New ENSv1 Registrations

current_state.zh: A governance proposal to activate ENSv2 would stop new ENSv1 registrations, allow existing .eth holders to migrate with no deadline, and hand ENS Labs' remaining ENSv2 admin roles over to the DAO.
current_state.en: A governance proposal to activate ENSv2 would stop new ENSv1 registrations, allow existing .eth holders to migrate with no deadline, and hand ENS Labs' remaining ENSv2 admin roles over to the DAO.
